verdict.rationale: Swell offers CSV import/export for products and categories (swell-docs-14) and a REST API for backend data access, but there's no evidence of a comprehensive, all-data export mechanism (orders, customers, subscriptions, custom models) in an open format for full portability/exit. Missing for 10: full-store data export/backup tooling, documented open-format export for entities beyond products, and any migration/exit-focused tooling or independent validation.
